Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in Step 2 by prematurely concluding that the ownership of Maxeda since 2004 was by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. (KKR) based on initial WebSurfer results. This conclusion was made without fully resolving the conflicting information from other sources, such as references to The Carlyle Group as an owner. The Planner failed to prioritize obtaining primary-source evidence to confirm or refute these conflicting claims before providing an updated understanding. This lack of thorough verification led to ambiguity and prolonged unnecessary iterations in the investigation process, ultimately delaying the correct resolution of the real-world problem.
